summary: Curanex Pharmaceuticals Inc filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose an update on a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency. The company received an additional 180-day compliance period until November 2, 2026, to regain compliance with the $1.00 closing bid price requirement. The filing does not describe a change of control, strategic transaction, or special situation event. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are mentioned. The company is considering a reverse stock split to cure the deficiency but there is no assurance of compliance. This is a routine listing-standards update.
